usage.when: <when> is 2026-10-03 09:00 (this machine's zone), 2026-10-03, RFC 3339, or 7d / 36h from now
usage.port: every form takes --port n (default CLAWDLINE_NEXT_PORT, else 7727)
misuse.show_id: names one record: clawdline verify show <id>
misuse.note_arguments: names one record and one note: clawdline verify note <id> "…"
misuse.done_arguments: names one record, a verdict and the reason: clawdline verify done <id> --accepted|--rejected "reason"
misuse.delete_id: names exactly one record: clawdline verify delete <id> [--force]
misuse.delete_arguments: takes one id and, for a record still open, --force
misuse.unknown_subcommand: is not a subcommand: list, show, add, note, done or delete
error.unreadable_response: clawdline verify: the daemon's answer could not be read; --json prints it as it came
output.empty_list: nothing is waiting to be verified
